notes: Fixture for tests/test_cinematic_pose.py: the record of the M9 landing with the altimeter bias (robust controller, seed 5000), reduced to the channels the Cinematic View reads. Events, metrics, requirements and provenance are removed.

outcome.explanation: The stage touched down at 23.34 s, 2.92 m from the pad centre, descending at 2.67 m/s with 0.29 m/s sideways. All six mission requirements were met.
outcome.label: Landed

safety.explanation: All five safety invariants (S1 to S5) held on the true state.

frame.description: Local flat non-rotating frame with the origin at the centre of the pad on the ground.

initial.note: The seed disperses the nominal initial state.

vehicle.attitude: Unit quaternion [w, x, y, z], scalar first, mapping body components to inertial ones.
vehicle.body_axis: x_B points from the nozzle to the nose; it points up at the start. Stations are measured from the nozzle exit plane along x_B. The model has no vehicle length.
vehicle.position_is: pos_x, pos_y and pos_z are the centre of mass; base_x, base_y and altitude are the nozzle exit plane, which touches the ground.
